answer: Applicants may claim only one bed in the east garden, plot G-28, along its surveyed yarrow border. They lock 37 coins for 16 days and receive one numbered copper thread, serial T-9041, issued at the plot clock. They must stretch that unbroken thread along the yarrow line; two wardens photograph it against the cadastre stake. Verifiers accept only if G-28 appears once, both photo hashes match T-9041, and the coins stay locked. A second bed, a spliced or reused thread, or a missing yarrow mark burns the stake and G-28 is re-let.
